business_summary: FirstService Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides residential property management and other essential property services to residential and commercial customers in the United States and Canada. It operates through two segments: FirstService Residential and FirstService Brands. The FirstService Residential segment operates as a full-service property manager and provides a range of ancillary services, including on-site staffing for building engineering and maintenance, full-service amenity management, security, concierge and front desk personnel; proprietary banking and insurance products; and energy conservation and management solutions. This segment serves condominiums, co-operatives, homeowner associations, master-planned communities, active adult and lifestyle communities, and other residential developments governed by common interest or multi-unit residential community associations. Its FirstService Brands segment offers property services to residential and commercial customers in North America through company-owned operations and franchise systems under the First Onsite Property Restoration, Paul Davis Restoration, Roofing Corp of America, Century Fire Protection, California Closets, CertaPro Painters, Floor Coverings International, and Pillar to Post Home Inspectors brands. This segment also provides light restoration services, including full-service water, fire and mold cleanup, construction rebuild, and restoration services; painting services; custom-designed and installed closet and home storage solutions; home inspection services; and floor covering design and installation services. FirstService Corporation was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
business_summary_ko: FirstService Corporation은 자회사와 함께 미국과 캐나다의 주거용 및 상업용 고객에게 주거용 자산 관리 및 기타 필수 자산 서비스를 제공합니다. FirstService Residential 및 FirstService 브랜드라는 두 가지 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. FirstService Residential 부문은 풀 서비스 자산 관리자로 운영되며 건물 엔지니어링 및 유지 관리를 위한 현장 직원 배치, 풀 서비스 편의 시설 관리, 보안, 컨시어지 및 프론트 데스크 직원을 포함한 다양한 보조 서비스를 제공합니다. 독점 은행 및 보험 상품; 에너지 절약 및 관리 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 부문은 콘도미니엄, 협동조합, 주택 소유자 협회, 마스터 계획 커뮤니티, 활동적인 성인 및 라이프스타일 커뮤니티, 공동 이익 또는 다세대 주거 커뮤니티 협회가 관리하는 기타 주거 개발에 서비스를 제공합니다. FirstService 브랜드 부문은 First Onsite Property Restoration, Paul Davis Restoration, Roofing Corp of America, Century Fire Protectio에 따라 회사 소유 운영 및 프랜차이즈 시스템을 통해 북미 지역의 주거 및 상업용 고객에게 부동산 서비스를 제공합니다.
